name: codex-agent-team
description: Codex Delegate compiles bounded delegation contracts, reuses established evidence, and schedules Luna, Terra, or Sol only when each call adds a distinct dependency.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate only bounded work that adds distinct value.
interface.longDescription: Codex Delegate keeps the current session in control, compiles bounded work into verifiable delegation contracts, uses Luna Max for execution, Terra only for unresolved complex technical deltas, and Sol High for selective judgment or review. Established evidence is reused so escalation resolves only the remaining dependency instead of restarting the task.
defaultPrompt: Use /codex-delegate to solve this coding task with the smallest useful compute graph and reuse established evidence across any Subagents.
Use /codex-delegate to implement this change with a bounded Luna contract, escalating only unresolved technical or judgment dependencies.
Use /codex-delegate to review this task without repeating work that existing evidence already proves.
